resources.string: Lets the floating companion read the page on screen when you ask it to summarize.
PocketLLM\'s companion reads the text on your screen only at the moment you tap "Summary" on the bubble. It cannot tap, type, or act on other apps.
Lets the agent read the screen and tap / type to complete your task on your behalf.

PocketLLM\'s accessibility agent reads the interactive elements on your screen and performs click / type actions to complete the task you ask for. Granting this gives the agent the ability to act on other apps.
